//go:build postingedgebench

package postingedge

import (
	"context"
	"math/rand/v2"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"slices"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"
	"unsafe"

	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/adapters/repos/db/vector/hnsw/distancer"
	enterrors "github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/errors"
	ent "github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/vectorindex/postingedge"
)

// The insert in two steps, a simulation (bench-report.md of
// feat/posting-edge-index, "Insert en dos tiempos: simulación", pre-registered
// on 2026-11-28 by the user's order). Nothing of the index is written: the
// postings of a clone are loaded into memory, their edges are changed there,
// and the search of the index is given the postings of that copy.

// simNeighbors is the most edges a vector has.
const simNeighbors = 16

// simIndex is the copy in memory of an index that grew.
type simIndex struct {
	p     *Persistent
	g     *growIndex
	store *nightStore
	dims  int
	keys  int
	words int
	// members and codes are, by posting, the doc ids of its members and
	// their scan codes; nil for a posting that is not alive.
	members [][]uint64
	codes   [][]uint64
	live    []uint32
	// deg, to and dist are, by doc id, the edges of a vector: how many, their
	// endpoints nearest first, and the exact distance of each.
	deg  []uint8
	to   []uint32
	dist []float32
	// vecs is the file of the exact vectors, mapped, and slotOf where the
	// vector of a doc id is in it (nil: at its doc id).
	vecs   []float32
	mapped []byte
	slotOf []uint32
	// place is, by doc id, when the vector came: its place in the order of
	// arrival.
	place []uint32
	count int
	// near is, by posting, its nearest live postings by the cosine of their
	// centroids, nearest first, simGroupMax of them; centroids has them,
	// normalized, by posting.
	near      [][]uint32
	centroids [][]float32
	// notices are, by doc id, the vectors that left it a notice: an inverse
	// edge that waits in memory, which a search follows as one more edge of
	// the vector when it loads its posting. Nil when there is none.
	notices map[uint32][]uint32
	rounds  sync.Pool
	logger  logrus.FieldLogger
}

const simGroupMax = 320

func (s *simIndex) vec(docID uint32) []float32 {
	slot := int(docID)
	if s.slotOf != nil {
		slot = int(s.slotOf[docID])
	}
	return s.vecs[slot*s.dims : (slot+1)*s.dims]
}

func (s *simIndex) edges(docID uint32) []uint32 {
	return s.to[int(docID)*simNeighbors : int(docID)*simNeighbors+int(s.deg[docID])]
}

func (s *simIndex) exact(a, b uint32) float32 {
	d, _ := s.g.provider.SingleDist(s.vec(a), s.vec(b))
	return d
}

// simOrder is the order the rows of a dataset went into an index grown by
// TestNightGrow: its shuffle.
func simOrder(rows int) []uint64 {
	order := make([]uint64, rows)
	for i := range order {
		order[i] = uint64(i)
	}
	rand.New(rand.NewPCG(1, 1)).Shuffle(len(order), func(i, j int) { order[i], order[j] = order[j], order[i] })
	return order
}

// openSim opens the index of dir with no cycle and no maintenance and loads
// it into memory. With dense, the doc id of a vector is its place in the
// order of arrival (PE_DENSE of TestNightGrow); without, its row.
func openSim(t *testing.T, dir string, dense bool) *simIndex {
	t.Helper()
	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	uc := ent.NewDefaultUserConfig()
	uc.RQ.CacheMode = ent.CacheModeRouting
	st := openNightStore(t, dir, logger, false)
	cfg := st.config(dir, logger, 0)
	cfg.noMaintenance = true
	p, err := Open(cfg, uc, st.store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	g := p.g
	require.NotNil(t, g, "the index has a base")
	s := &simIndex{
		p: p, g: g, store: st, dims: g.meta.Dims, keys: g.meta.Keys, words: g.meta.ScanCodeWords, logger: logger,
		members: make([][]uint64, g.meta.Postings), codes: make([][]uint64, g.meta.Postings),
		deg: make([]uint8, g.meta.Keys), to: make([]uint32, g.meta.Keys*simNeighbors),
		dist: make([]float32, g.meta.Keys*simNeighbors), slotOf: g.slotOf, count: g.meta.Live,
	}
	s.rounds.New = func() any { return &diskRound{} }

	// The postings, as a search fetches them.
	begin := time.Now()
	var round diskRound
	const chunk = 32
	picks := make([]scored, 0, chunk)
	flush := func() {
		if len(picks) == 0 {
			return
		}
		require.NoError(t, g.fetch(&round, picks))
		for i, pick := range picks {
			post := &round.postings[i].post
			q := uint32(pick.id)
			s.members[q], s.codes[q] = slices.Clone(post.docIDs), slices.Clone(post.codes)
			for m, id := range post.docIDs {
				list := post.edgesOf(m)
				require.LessOrEqual(t, len(list), simNeighbors)
				s.deg[id] = uint8(len(list))
				copy(s.to[int(id)*simNeighbors:], list)
			}
		}
		picks = picks[:0]
	}
	for q := 0; q < g.meta.Postings; q++ {
		if g.retired[q] || g.size[q] == 0 {
			continue
		}
		s.live = append(s.live, uint32(q))
		picks = append(picks, scored{id: uint64(q)})
		if len(picks) == chunk {
			flush()
		}
	}
	flush()
	t.Logf("%d postings loaded in %s", len(s.live), time.Since(begin).Round(time.Millisecond))

	// The exact vectors: their file, mapped.
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "main.postingedge.d", growVectorsName(g.meta.VectorGen))
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	info, err := file.Stat()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	s.mapped, err = syscall.Mmap(int(file.Fd()), 0, int(info.Size()), syscall.PROT_READ, syscall.MAP_SHARED)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, file.Close())
	s.vecs = unsafe.Slice((*float32)(unsafe.Pointer(&s.mapped[0])), len(s.mapped)/4)

	// When each vector came.
	s.place = make([]uint32, s.keys)
	if dense {
		for id := range s.place {
			s.place[id] = uint32(id)
		}
	} else {
		for at, row := range simOrder(s.count) {
			s.place[row] = uint32(at)
		}
	}

	// The distance of every edge.
	begin = time.Now()
	s.parallel(s.keys, func(_, from, to int) {
		for id := from; id < to; id++ {
			for i, e := range s.edges(uint32(id)) {
				s.dist[id*simNeighbors+i] = s.exact(uint32(id), e)
			}
		}
	})
	t.Logf("the distances of the edges in %s", time.Since(begin).Round(time.Millisecond))

	// The nearest postings of each, by the cosine of their centroids.
	begin = time.Now()
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "main.postingedge.d", diskCentroidFile))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Len(t, raw, 4*s.dims*g.meta.Postings, "the file of the centroids")
	centroids := make([][]float32, g.meta.Postings)
	for _, q := range s.live {
		c := make([]float32, s.dims)
		for i := range c {
			c[i] = getFloat32(raw[4*(int(q)*s.dims+i):])
		}
		centroids[q] = distancer.Normalize(c)
	}
	s.near = make([][]uint32, g.meta.Postings)
	s.centroids = centroids
	dot := distancer.NewCosineDistanceProvider()
	s.parallel(len(s.live), func(_, from, to int) {
		var best topK
		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
			q := s.live[i]
			best.reset(simGroupMax)
			for _, other := range s.live {
				if other == q {
					continue
				}
				d, _ := dot.SingleDist(centroids[q], centroids[other])
				best.push(uint64(other), d)
			}
			list := make([]uint32, 0, simGroupMax)
			for _, b := range best.sorted() {
				list = append(list, uint32(b.id))
			}
			s.near[q] = list
		}
	})
	t.Logf("the nearest postings of every posting in %s", time.Since(begin).Round(time.Millisecond))
	return s
}

func (s *simIndex) close(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	require.NoError(t, syscall.Munmap(s.mapped))
	require.NoError(t, s.p.Shutdown(ctx))
	require.NoError(t, s.store.store.Shutdown(ctx))
}

// parallel runs f over [0, n) in chunks, on every processor.
func (s *simIndex) parallel(n int, f func(worker, from, to int)) {
	workers := runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)
	const chunk = 64
	var next atomic.Int64
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for w := range workers {
		wg.Add(1)
		enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			for {
				from := int(next.Add(chunk)) - chunk
				if from >= n {
					return
				}
				f(w, from, min(from+chunk, n))
			}
		}, s.logger)
	}
	wg.Wait()
}

// simState is the edges and the members of the copy, to go back to.
type simState struct {
	deg     []uint8
	to      []uint32
	dist    []float32
	members [][]uint64
	codes   [][]uint64
}

func (s *simIndex) snapshot() *simState {
	return &simState{
		deg: slices.Clone(s.deg), to: slices.Clone(s.to), dist: slices.Clone(s.dist),
		members: slices.Clone(s.members), codes: slices.Clone(s.codes),
	}
}

func (s *simIndex) restore(st *simState) {
	s.notices = nil
	copy(s.deg, st.deg)
	copy(s.to, st.to)
	copy(s.dist, st.dist)
	copy(s.members, st.members)
	copy(s.codes, st.codes)
}

// fetch gives a search the postings of the copy, with the edges they have in
// it.
func (s *simIndex) fetch(round *diskRound, picks []scored) error {
	if cap(round.postings) < len(picks) {
		round.postings = append(round.postings[:cap(round.postings)], make([]diskPosting, len(picks)-cap(round.postings))...)
	}
	round.postings = round.postings[:len(picks)]
	for i, pick := range picks {
		q, dp := uint32(pick.id), &round.postings[i]
		ids := s.members[q]
		dp.edgeStart = resized(dp.edgeStart, len(ids)+1)
		dp.edges = dp.edges[:0]
		dp.edgeStart[0] = 0
		for m, id := range ids {
			dp.edges = append(dp.edges, s.edges(uint32(id))...)
			if s.notices != nil {
				dp.edges = append(dp.edges, s.notices[uint32(id)]...)
			}
			dp.edgeStart[m+1] = uint32(len(dp.edges))
		}
		dp.bytes, dp.took = [3]int{}, [3]time.Duration{}
		dp.post = posting{docIDs: ids, codes: s.codes[q], edges: dp.edges, edgeStart: dp.edgeStart, byDocID: true}
	}
	return nil
}

// simPoint is the copy searched at one ef.
type simPoint struct {
	Target float64 `json:"target,omitempty"`
	EF     int     `json:"ef"`
	Recall float64 `json:"recall"`
	Loads  float64 `json:"loads"`
}

// eval searches the queries over the copy at one ef, with the search of the
// index, and tells the recall against truth and the postings a query loaded.
func (s *simIndex) eval(t *testing.T, queries [][]float32, truth [][]uint64, ef int) simPoint {
	t.Helper()
	const k = 10
	ctx := context.Background()
	var next, hits, loads atomic.Int64
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	errs := make([]error, 8)
	for worker := range 8 {
		wg.Add(1)
		enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			search := &fetchedSearch{
				ix: s.g.ix, st: s.g.st, rounds: &s.rounds, fetch: s.fetch, grown: true,
				haloWords: s.g.meta.RoutingCodeWords, ef: ef,
			}
			for {
				q := int(next.Add(1)) - 1
				if q >= len(queries) {
					return
				}
				var stats diskSearchStats
				found, _, err := search.run(ctx, queries[q], k, nil, &stats)
				if err != nil {
					errs[worker] = err
					return
				}
				for _, want := range truth[q] {
					if slices.Contains(found, want) {
						hits.Add(1)
					}
				}
				loads.Add(int64(stats.Postings))
			}
		}, s.logger)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	for _, err := range errs {
		require.NoError(t, err)
	}
	n := float64(len(queries))
	return simPoint{EF: ef, Recall: float64(hits.Load()) / (n * k), Loads: float64(loads.Load()) / n}
}

// simCurve is the copy searched over the grid of ef, and at the smallest ef
// that reaches every target recall; Missed tells the targets it does not
// reach by ef 2048.
type simCurve struct {
	Grid   []simPoint `json:"grid"`
	Points []simPoint `json:"points"`
	Missed []float64  `json:"missed,omitempty"`
}

func (s *simIndex) curve(t *testing.T, queries [][]float32, truth [][]uint64) simCurve {
	t.Helper()
	const k = 10
	seen := map[int]simPoint{}
	at := func(ef int) simPoint {
		if point, ok := seen[ef]; ok {
			return point
		}
		point := s.eval(t, queries, truth, ef)
		seen[ef] = point
		return point
	}
	var out simCurve
	for _, ef := range []int{10, 20, 40, 80, 160, 320} {
		out.Grid = append(out.Grid, at(ef))
	}
	for _, target := range []float64{0.95, 0.99} {
		low, high := k-1, k
		reached := at(high)
		for reached.Recall < target && high < 2048 {
			low, high = high, 2*high
			reached = at(high)
		}
		if reached.Recall < target {
			out.Missed = append(out.Missed, target)
			continue
		}
		for high-low > 1 {
			mid := (low + high) / 2
			if point := at(mid); point.Recall >= target {
				high, reached = mid, point
			} else {
				low = mid
			}
		}
		reached.Target = target
		out.Points = append(out.Points, reached)
	}
	return out
}

// strip takes the edges of the given vectors away, and takes the vectors out
// of the lists of every other: they stay in their postings. It tells how many
// edges went of each kind.
func (s *simIndex) strip(gone []bool) (own, inverse int) {
	for id := range s.deg {
		if gone[id] {
			own += int(s.deg[id])
			s.deg[id] = 0
			continue
		}
		list := s.edges(uint32(id))
		kept := 0
		for i, e := range list {
			if gone[e] {
				inverse++
				continue
			}
			s.to[id*simNeighbors+kept], s.dist[id*simNeighbors+kept] = e, s.dist[id*simNeighbors+i]
			kept++
		}
		s.deg[id] = uint8(kept)
	}
	return own, inverse
}

// remove takes the given vectors out of the copy as if they had never been:
// out of their postings and out of every list.
func (s *simIndex) remove(gone []bool) {
	s.strip(gone)
	for _, q := range s.live {
		ids, codes := s.members[q], s.codes[q]
		var keptIDs []uint64
		var keptCodes []uint64
		for m, id := range ids {
			if gone[id] {
				continue
			}
			keptIDs = append(keptIDs, id)
			keptCodes = append(keptCodes, codes[m*s.words:(m+1)*s.words]...)
		}
		if len(keptIDs) != len(ids) {
			s.members[q], s.codes[q] = keptIDs, keptCodes
		}
	}
}

// recent marks the given share of the vectors that came last.
func (s *simIndex) recent(share float64) []bool {
	mark := make([]bool, s.keys)
	first := uint32(float64(s.count) * (1 - share))
	postingOf := s.g.st.side.postingOf
	for _, q := range s.live {
		for _, id := range s.members[q] {
			if s.place[id] >= first && postingOf[id] == q {
				mark[id] = true
			}
		}
	}
	return mark
}

// random marks the given share of the vectors, picked at random with a fixed
// seed.
func (s *simIndex) random(share float64) []bool {
	mark := make([]bool, s.keys)
	rng := rand.New(rand.NewPCG(11, 3))
	postingOf := s.g.st.side.postingOf
	for _, q := range s.live {
		for _, id := range s.members[q] {
			if postingOf[id] == q && rng.Float64() < share {
				mark[id] = true
			}
		}
	}
	return mark
}

// simSpread is how a set of vectors spreads over the postings: the share of
// the members of a posting that are of the set, over the live postings.
type simSpread struct {
	Share   float64 `json:"share"`
	Vectors int     `json:"vectors"`
	Mean    float64 `json:"meanShareOfAPosting"`
	Min     float64 `json:"min"`
	P1      float64 `json:"p1"`
	P10     float64 `json:"p10"`
	P25     float64 `json:"p25"`
	P50     float64 `json:"p50"`
	P75     float64 `json:"p75"`
	P90     float64 `json:"p90"`
	P99     float64 `json:"p99"`
	Max     float64 `json:"max"`
	// None is the postings with no vector of the set; Twice the postings
	// where the set is twice its share of the index or more, and InTwice the
	// part of the set that lives in them.
	None    int     `json:"postingsWithNone"`
	Twice   int     `json:"postingsWithTwiceTheShare"`
	InTwice float64 `json:"ofTheSetInThose"`
	// OutEdges and InEdges are the edges of the vectors of the set and the
	// edges of the others that lead to them, a vector of the set.
	OutEdges float64 `json:"outEdgesAVector"`
	InEdges  float64 `json:"inEdgesAVector"`
}

// spread measures simSpread for the vectors marked.
func (s *simIndex) spread(share float64, mark []bool) simSpread {
	out := simSpread{Share: share}
	shares := make([]float64, 0, len(s.live))
	counts := make([]int, 0, len(s.live))
	for _, q := range s.live {
		n := 0
		for _, id := range s.members[q] {
			if mark[id] {
				n++
				out.OutEdges += float64(s.deg[id])
			}
			for _, e := range s.edges(uint32(id)) {
				if mark[e] && !mark[id] {
					out.InEdges++
				}
			}
		}
		out.Vectors += n
		counts = append(counts, n)
		shares = append(shares, float64(n)/float64(max(len(s.members[q]), 1)))
	}
	inTwice := 0
	for i, sh := range shares {
		out.Mean += sh / float64(len(shares))
		if counts[i] == 0 {
			out.None++
		}
		if sh >= 2*share {
			out.Twice++
			inTwice += counts[i]
		}
	}
	if out.Vectors > 0 {
		out.InTwice = float64(inTwice) / float64(out.Vectors)
		out.OutEdges /= float64(out.Vectors)
		out.InEdges /= float64(out.Vectors)
	}
	slices.Sort(shares)
	at := func(q float64) float64 { return shares[min(len(shares)-1, int(q*float64(len(shares))))] }
	out.Min, out.P1, out.P10, out.P25, out.P50 = shares[0], at(0.01), at(0.10), at(0.25), at(0.50)
	out.P75, out.P90, out.P99, out.Max = at(0.75), at(0.90), at(0.99), shares[len(shares)-1]
	return out
}

// simProv is what giving the pending vectors provisional edges did.
type simProv struct {
	K          int   `json:"companions"`
	Vectors    int   `json:"vectors"`
	Companions int64 `json:"companionsScoredByCode"`
	Endpoints  int64 `json:"endpointsScoredByCode"`
	Edges      int64 `json:"edges"`
	NoEdge     int   `json:"vectorsLeftWithNone"`
	// InverseChecks and InverseEdges are the lists of neighbors it looked
	// at and those it entered, when it takes its place in them.
	InverseChecks int64 `json:"inverseChecks,omitempty"`
	InverseEdges  int64 `json:"inverseEdges,omitempty"`
	// Notices is the notices it left, NoticeTargets the vectors that hold
	// some once it is done, and NoticeMax the most one of them holds.
	Notices       int64   `json:"notices,omitempty"`
	NoticeTargets int     `json:"vectorsWithNotices,omitempty"`
	NoticeMax     int     `json:"mostNoticesOnAVector,omitempty"`
	Seconds       float64 `json:"seconds"`
	CPUSeconds    float64 `json:"cpuSeconds"`
}

// add adds what another round of provisional edges did to this one.
func (v *simProv) add(o simProv) {
	v.K = o.K
	v.Vectors += o.Vectors
	v.Companions += o.Companions
	v.Endpoints += o.Endpoints
	v.Edges += o.Edges
	v.NoEdge += o.NoEdge
	v.InverseChecks += o.InverseChecks
	v.InverseEdges += o.InverseEdges
	v.Notices += o.Notices
	v.NoticeTargets, v.NoticeMax = o.NoticeTargets, max(v.NoticeMax, o.NoticeMax)
	v.Seconds += o.Seconds
	v.CPUSeconds += o.CPUSeconds
}

// provisional gives the pending vectors, in the order they came, the edges
// an insert with no search would give them: each has its posting alone,
// ranks by the code of its row the companions that came before it, takes the
// endpoints of the edges of the k nearest, ranks them by the routing code
// the index keeps in memory by doc id, and keeps the simNeighbors nearest,
// with the distance the code tells. No exact vector is read. Without inverse
// it enters the list of nobody: what a vector reads and writes is of its
// posting, so the postings go in parallel, each in the order its vectors
// came. With inverse 1 it also takes its place in the lists of those
// neighbors, by the distance the code tells against the distances they
// hold, as an insert does (enterNeighbors); with inverse 2 it leaves each of
// them a notice instead, with no list read: an edge that waits in memory and
// that a search follows when it loads the posting of the neighbor. Then the
// vectors go one after another, in the order they came.
func (s *simIndex) provisional(t *testing.T, pending []bool, k int, inverse int) simProv {
	t.Helper()
	begin := time.Now()
	usage, err := readDiagRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	st := s.g.st
	side := st.side
	scanQuantizer := st.scanQuantizer
	if scanQuantizer == nil {
		scanQuantizer = st.quantizer
	}
	var vectors, noEdge atomic.Int64
	var companions, endpoints, edges atomic.Int64
	var failed atomic.Pointer[error]
	// one gives vector v of posting q its provisional edges, and tells
	// whether it went well.
	one := func(q, v uint32, byCode, nearest *topK, seen map[uint32]struct{}) bool {
		ids, codes := s.members[q], s.codes[q]
		vector := s.vec(v)
		scan := scanQuantizer.NewEstimator(vector)
		routing := st.quantizer.NewEstimator(vector)
		byCode.reset(k)
		scoredHere := 0
		for c, id := range ids {
			if uint32(id) == v || s.place[id] >= s.place[v] {
				continue
			}
			d, err := scan.Distance(codes[c*s.words : (c+1)*s.words])
			if err != nil {
				failed.Store(&err)
				return false
			}
			byCode.push(id, d)
			scoredHere++
		}
		companions.Add(int64(scoredHere))
		clear(seen)
		nearest.reset(simNeighbors)
		for _, companion := range byCode.items {
			for _, e := range s.edges(uint32(companion.id)) {
				if _, ok := seen[e]; ok || e == v {
					continue
				}
				seen[e] = struct{}{}
				d, err := routing.Distance(side.code(e))
				if err != nil {
					failed.Store(&err)
					return false
				}
				nearest.push(uint64(e), d)
			}
		}
		endpoints.Add(int64(len(seen)))
		n := 0
		for _, nb := range nearest.sorted() {
			s.to[int(v)*simNeighbors+n], s.dist[int(v)*simNeighbors+n] = uint32(nb.id), nb.dist
			n++
		}
		s.deg[v] = uint8(n)
		edges.Add(int64(n))
		vectors.Add(1)
		if n == 0 {
			noEdge.Add(1)
		}
		return true
	}
	var inverseChecks, inverseEdges, notices int64
	if inverse == 0 {
		s.parallel(len(s.live), func(_, from, to int) {
			var byCode, nearest topK
			seen := map[uint32]struct{}{}
			var order []int
			for i := from; i < to; i++ {
				q := s.live[i]
				ids := s.members[q]
				order = order[:0]
				for m, id := range ids {
					if pending[id] {
						order = append(order, m)
					}
				}
				slices.SortFunc(order, func(a, b int) int { return int(s.place[ids[a]]) - int(s.place[ids[b]]) })
				for _, m := range order {
					if !one(q, uint32(ids[m]), &byCode, &nearest, seen) {
						return
					}
				}
			}
		})
	} else {
		postingOf := side.postingOf
		var order []uint32
		for _, q := range s.live {
			for _, id := range s.members[q] {
				if pending[id] {
					order = append(order, uint32(id))
				}
			}
		}
		slices.SortFunc(order, func(a, b uint32) int { return int(s.place[a]) - int(s.place[b]) })
		var byCode, nearest topK
		seen := map[uint32]struct{}{}
		for _, v := range order {
			if !one(postingOf[v], v, &byCode, &nearest, seen) {
				break
			}
			if inverse == 2 {
				// A notice to each of its neighbors: nothing of theirs is
				// read.
				if s.notices == nil {
					s.notices = map[uint32][]uint32{}
				}
				for j := 0; j < int(s.deg[v]); j++ {
					u := s.to[int(v)*simNeighbors+j]
					s.notices[u] = append(s.notices[u], v)
					notices++
				}
				continue
			}
			// Its place in the lists of its neighbors, by what the code
			// tells against the distances they hold.
			for j := 0; j < int(s.deg[v]); j++ {
				u, d := s.to[int(v)*simNeighbors+j], s.dist[int(v)*simNeighbors+j]
				list := s.edges(u)
				if len(list) == 0 || slices.Contains(list, v) {
					continue
				}
				inverseChecks++
				dists := s.dist[int(u)*simNeighbors : int(u)*simNeighbors+len(list)]
				if d >= dists[len(list)-1] {
					continue
				}
				at := len(list) - 1
				for at > 0 && dists[at-1] > d {
					at--
				}
				copy(list[at+1:], list[at:len(list)-1])
				copy(dists[at+1:], dists[at:len(dists)-1])
				list[at], dists[at] = v, d
				inverseEdges++
			}
		}
	}
	if err := failed.Load(); err != nil {
		require.NoError(t, *err)
	}
	after, err := readDiagRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	out := simProv{
		K: k, Vectors: int(vectors.Load()), Companions: companions.Load(), Endpoints: endpoints.Load(),
		Edges: edges.Load(), NoEdge: int(noEdge.Load()), InverseChecks: inverseChecks, InverseEdges: inverseEdges,
		Notices: notices, Seconds: time.Since(begin).Seconds(),
		CPUSeconds: float64(after.UserNs+after.SystemNs-usage.UserNs-usage.SystemNs) / 1e9,
	}
	// The vectors that hold notices now, and the most one holds.
	out.NoticeTargets = len(s.notices)
	for _, list := range s.notices {
		out.NoticeMax = max(out.NoticeMax, len(list))
	}
	return out
}

// simCost is what a pass of events did.
type simCost struct {
	Events    int   `json:"events"`
	Connected int   `json:"vectorsConnected"`
	Loads     int64 `json:"postingsLoaded"`
	Scored    int64 `json:"candidatesScoredByCode"`
	Exact     int64 `json:"exactDistances"`
	// ExactDistinct is the vectors those distances read, counted once per
	// event: what an event would read of the file of the vectors.
	ExactDistinct  int64   `json:"exactVectorsDistinctPerEvent"`
	Edges          int64   `json:"ownEdges"`
	InverseChecks  int64   `json:"inverseChecks"`
	InverseEdges   int64   `json:"inverseEdges"`
	Seconds        float64 `json:"seconds"`
	CPUSeconds     float64 `json:"cpuSeconds"`
	GroupPostings  float64 `json:"groupPostingsMean"`
	PendingPerEvnt float64 `json:"connectedPerEvent"`
	// CentroidDists is the distances of the targets to the centroids of
	// their groups, with candidates by vector.
	CentroidDists int64 `json:"centroidDistances,omitempty"`
}

// add adds the cost of another pass of events to this one.
func (c *simCost) add(o simCost) {
	groups := c.GroupPostings*float64(c.Events) + o.GroupPostings*float64(o.Events)
	c.Events += o.Events
	c.Connected += o.Connected
	c.Loads += o.Loads
	c.Scored += o.Scored
	c.Exact += o.Exact
	c.ExactDistinct += o.ExactDistinct
	c.Edges += o.Edges
	c.InverseChecks += o.InverseChecks
	c.InverseEdges += o.InverseEdges
	c.Seconds += o.Seconds
	c.CPUSeconds += o.CPUSeconds
	c.CentroidDists += o.CentroidDists
	if c.Events > 0 {
		c.GroupPostings = groups / float64(c.Events)
		c.PendingPerEvnt = float64(c.Connected) / float64(c.Events)
	}
}

// simEventOpts is what a pass of events does besides connecting its targets
// from the whole of their groups.
type simEventOpts struct {
	// keepOwn has a pending target compare exactly the edges it has, the
	// provisional ones, with its candidates: those still among its nearest
	// stay.
	keepOwn bool
	// perVector, when positive, has each target score its posting and the
	// perVector postings of its group whose centroids are nearest to it,
	// not the whole group.
	perVector int
	// upTo, when positive, is the place in the order of arrival from which
	// the vectors are not in the index yet: they are candidates of nobody.
	upTo uint32
}

// groupOf is the group of a posting: by its nearest centroids ("a"), or by
// the postings the edges of its members that are not targets point to most
// ("b").
func (s *simIndex) groupOf(def string, q uint32, size int, target []bool, counts []uint32, touched *[]uint32) []uint32 {
	if def == "a" {
		return s.near[q][:min(size, len(s.near[q]))]
	}
	postingOf := s.g.st.side.postingOf
	*touched = (*touched)[:0]
	for _, id := range s.members[q] {
		if target != nil && target[id] {
			continue
		}
		for _, e := range s.edges(uint32(id)) {
			to := postingOf[e]
			if to == q {
				continue
			}
			if counts[to] == 0 {
				*touched = append(*touched, to)
			}
			counts[to]++
		}
	}
	list := slices.Clone(*touched)
	slices.SortFunc(list, func(a, b uint32) int {
		switch {
		case counts[a] != counts[b]:
			return int(counts[b]) - int(counts[a])
		case a < b:
			return -1
		case a > b:
			return 1
		}
		return 0
	})
	for _, to := range *touched {
		counts[to] = 0
	}
	return list[:min(size, len(list))]
}

// events runs one pass of events over the postings, in their order: each
// loads its group once and connects its targets, the pending members with
// all false, every member with all true, and enters them in the lists of
// their neighbors as an insert does. rescore is how many of the candidates
// ranked by code are compared exactly.
func (s *simIndex) events(t *testing.T, def string, size, rescore int, pending []bool, all bool, only []bool,
	opts simEventOpts,
) simCost {
	t.Helper()
	begin := time.Now()
	usage, err := readDiagRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	postingOf := s.g.st.side.postingOf
	quantizer := s.g.st.scanQuantizer
	if quantizer == nil {
		quantizer = s.g.st.quantizer
	}
	workers := runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)
	type scratch struct {
		byCode, nearest, postings topK
		seen                      map[uint32]struct{}
	}
	dot := distancer.NewCosineDistanceProvider()
	scratches := make([]scratch, workers)
	for w := range scratches {
		scratches[w].seen = map[uint32]struct{}{}
	}
	type found struct {
		ids    [simNeighbors]uint32
		dists  [simNeighbors]float32
		n      int
		exact  int
		scored int
	}
	var poolFrom []uint32
	var poolStart []int
	var cost simCost
	counts := make([]uint32, len(s.members))
	var touched []uint32
	var poolIDs []uint32
	var poolCodes [][]uint64
	var targets []uint32
	var results []found
	distinct := map[uint32]struct{}{}
	var groups int64

	for _, q := range s.live {
		if only != nil && !only[q] {
			continue
		}
		targets = targets[:0]
		for _, id := range s.members[q] {
			if all || pending[id] {
				targets = append(targets, uint32(id))
			}
		}
		if len(targets) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		var target []bool
		if !all {
			target = pending
		}
		group := s.groupOf(def, q, size, target, counts, &touched)
		poolIDs, poolCodes = poolIDs[:0], poolCodes[:0]
		poolFrom, poolStart = poolFrom[:0], poolStart[:0]
		for _, from := range append([]uint32{q}, group...) {
			poolFrom, poolStart = append(poolFrom, from), append(poolStart, len(poolIDs))
			codes := s.codes[from]
			for m, id := range s.members[from] {
				if opts.upTo > 0 && s.place[id] >= opts.upTo {
					continue
				}
				poolIDs = append(poolIDs, uint32(id))
				poolCodes = append(poolCodes, codes[m*s.words:(m+1)*s.words])
			}
		}
		poolStart = append(poolStart, len(poolIDs))
		cost.Events++
		cost.Loads += int64(1 + len(group))
		groups += int64(len(group))
		if cap(results) < len(targets) {
			results = make([]found, len(targets))
		}
		results = results[:len(targets)]

		// The neighbors of every target, each on its own: nothing is written.
		var next atomic.Int64
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		var failed atomic.Pointer[error]
		for w := range workers {
			wg.Add(1)
			enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				sc := &scratches[w]
				for {
					i := int(next.Add(1)) - 1
					if i >= len(targets) {
						return
					}
					v := targets[i]
					vector := s.vec(v)
					estimator := quantizer.NewEstimator(vector)
					sc.byCode.reset(rescore)
					scoredHere := 0
					score := func(from, to int) bool {
						for c := from; c < to; c++ {
							id := poolIDs[c]
							if id == v {
								continue
							}
							d, err := estimator.Distance(poolCodes[c])
							if err != nil {
								failed.Store(&err)
								return false
							}
							sc.byCode.push(uint64(id), d)
							scoredHere++
						}
						return true
					}
					if opts.perVector > 0 && opts.perVector < len(poolFrom)-1 {
						// Its posting, and the postings of the group nearest
						// to the vector itself.
						sc.postings.reset(opts.perVector)
						for g := 1; g < len(poolFrom); g++ {
							d, _ := dot.SingleDist(vector, s.centroids[poolFrom[g]])
							sc.postings.push(uint64(g), d)
						}
						if !score(poolStart[0], poolStart[1]) {
							return
						}
						for _, pick := range sc.postings.items {
							if !score(poolStart[pick.id], poolStart[pick.id+1]) {
								return
							}
						}
					} else if !score(0, len(poolIDs)) {
						return
					}
					clear(sc.seen)
					sc.nearest.reset(simNeighbors)
					exact := 0
					for _, cand := range sc.byCode.items {
						sc.seen[uint32(cand.id)] = struct{}{}
						d, _ := s.g.provider.SingleDist(vector, s.vec(uint32(cand.id)))
						sc.nearest.push(cand.id, d)
						exact++
					}
					if all && !(pending != nil && pending[v]) {
						// A member that had its edges keeps those that are
						// still among its nearest.
						for j, e := range s.edges(v) {
							if _, ok := sc.seen[e]; ok {
								continue
							}
							sc.nearest.push(uint64(e), s.dist[int(v)*simNeighbors+j])
						}
					} else if opts.keepOwn {
						// A pending vector that has provisional edges: each
						// is compared exactly, and stays if it is still
						// among its nearest.
						for _, e := range s.edges(v) {
							if _, ok := sc.seen[e]; ok {
								continue
							}
							sc.seen[e] = struct{}{}
							d, _ := s.g.provider.SingleDist(vector, s.vec(e))
							sc.nearest.push(uint64(e), d)
							exact++
						}
					}
					r := &results[i]
					r.n, r.exact, r.scored = 0, exact, scoredHere
					for _, nb := range sc.nearest.sorted() {
						r.ids[r.n], r.dists[r.n] = uint32(nb.id), nb.dist
						r.n++
					}
				}
			}, s.logger)
		}
		wg.Wait()
		if err := failed.Load(); err != nil {
			require.NoError(t, *err)
		}
		if opts.perVector > 0 && opts.perVector < len(poolFrom)-1 {
			cost.CentroidDists += int64(len(targets)) * int64(len(poolFrom)-1)
		}

		// What the event writes, one target after another.
		clear(distinct)
		for i, v := range targets {
			r := &results[i]
			cost.Exact += int64(r.exact)
			cost.Scored += int64(r.scored)
			n := 0
			for j := 0; j < r.n; j++ {
				distinct[r.ids[j]] = struct{}{}
				if postingOf[r.ids[j]] == q {
					continue
				}
				s.to[int(v)*simNeighbors+n], s.dist[int(v)*simNeighbors+n] = r.ids[j], r.dists[j]
				n++
			}
			s.deg[v] = uint8(n)
			cost.Edges += int64(n)
			cost.Connected++
			// Its place in the lists of its neighbors outside its posting, as
			// an insert takes it (enterNeighbors).
			for j := 0; j < r.n; j++ {
				u, d := r.ids[j], r.dists[j]
				if postingOf[u] == q {
					continue
				}
				list := s.edges(u)
				if len(list) == 0 || slices.Contains(list, v) {
					continue
				}
				cost.InverseChecks++
				dists := s.dist[int(u)*simNeighbors : int(u)*simNeighbors+len(list)]
				if d >= dists[len(list)-1] {
					continue
				}
				at := len(list) - 1
				for at > 0 && dists[at-1] > d {
					at--
				}
				copy(list[at+1:], list[at:len(list)-1])
				copy(dists[at+1:], dists[at:len(dists)-1])
				list[at], dists[at] = v, d
				cost.InverseEdges++
			}
		}
		// The vectors an event reads exactly, once each: the candidates of
		// all its targets together. Counted over the neighbors kept, which
		// is the least; over all the candidates it is ExactDistances at most.
		cost.ExactDistinct += int64(len(distinct))
	}
	after, err := readDiagRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	cost.Seconds = time.Since(begin).Seconds()
	cost.CPUSeconds = float64(after.UserNs+after.SystemNs-usage.UserNs-usage.SystemNs) / 1e9
	if cost.Events > 0 {
		cost.GroupPostings = float64(groups) / float64(cost.Events)
		cost.PendingPerEvnt = float64(cost.Connected) / float64(cost.Events)
	}
	return cost
}

// batchLike connects every vector by the rule of the batch builder
// (buildEdges), in the copy: its candidates are the members of the group
// postings whose centroids are nearest to the vector itself, ranked by code;
// the best rescore of them are compared exactly, and of the simNeighbors
// nearest those outside its posting are its edges. It enters the list of
// nobody. Each vector writes its own list alone, so they go in parallel.
func (s *simIndex) batchLike(t *testing.T, group, rescore int) simCost {
	t.Helper()
	begin := time.Now()
	usage, err := readDiagRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	ctx := context.Background()
	postingOf := s.g.st.side.postingOf
	quantizer := s.g.st.scanQuantizer
	if quantizer == nil {
		quantizer = s.g.st.quantizer
	}
	var connected, loads, scored, exact, edges atomic.Int64
	var failed atomic.Pointer[error]
	s.parallel(len(s.live), func(_, from, to int) {
		var byCode, nearest topK
		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
			q := s.live[i]
			for _, id := range s.members[q] {
				v := uint32(id)
				if postingOf[v] != q {
					continue
				}
				vector := s.vec(v)
				near, err := s.g.st.centroids.nearest(ctx, vector, group)
				if err != nil {
					failed.Store(&err)
					return
				}
				estimator := quantizer.NewEstimator(vector)
				byCode.reset(rescore)
				scoredHere, loaded := 0, 0
				for _, p := range near {
					if int(p) >= len(s.members) || s.members[p] == nil {
						continue
					}
					loaded++
					codes := s.codes[p]
					for m, candidate := range s.members[p] {
						if uint32(candidate) == v {
							continue
						}
						d, err := estimator.Distance(codes[m*s.words : (m+1)*s.words])
						if err != nil {
							failed.Store(&err)
							return
						}
						byCode.push(candidate, d)
						scoredHere++
					}
				}
				nearest.reset(simNeighbors)
				for _, candidate := range byCode.items {
					d, _ := s.g.provider.SingleDist(vector, s.vec(uint32(candidate.id)))
					nearest.push(candidate.id, d)
				}
				exact.Add(int64(len(byCode.items)))
				n := 0
				for _, nb := range nearest.sorted() {
					if postingOf[nb.id] == q {
						continue
					}
					s.to[int(v)*simNeighbors+n], s.dist[int(v)*simNeighbors+n] = uint32(nb.id), nb.dist
					n++
				}
				s.deg[v] = uint8(n)
				connected.Add(1)
				loads.Add(int64(loaded))
				scored.Add(int64(scoredHere))
				edges.Add(int64(n))
			}
		}
	})
	if err := failed.Load(); err != nil {
		require.NoError(t, *err)
	}
	after, err := readDiagRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return simCost{
		Events: int(connected.Load()), Connected: int(connected.Load()), Loads: loads.Load(), Scored: scored.Load(),
		Exact: exact.Load(), Edges: edges.Load(), Seconds: time.Since(begin).Seconds(),
		CPUSeconds:    float64(after.UserNs+after.SystemNs-usage.UserNs-usage.SystemNs) / 1e9,
		GroupPostings: float64(group), PendingPerEvnt: 1,
	}
}

// simCoverage is, for one size of group, how many of the edges of today lead
// to a posting of the group of the posting of their vector, by the two
// definitions of group.
type simCoverage struct {
	Size int `json:"group"`
	// Edges is the share of all the edges; Mean the mean over the vectors
	// that have edges of the share of theirs; Most and All the share of
	// those vectors with 90 % or more of theirs, and with all of them.
	ByCentroids simShare `json:"byCentroids"`
	ByEdges     simShare `json:"byEdges"`
}

type simShare struct {
	Edges float64 `json:"edges"`
	Mean  float64 `json:"meanPerVector"`
	Most  float64 `json:"vectorsWith90"`
	All   float64 `json:"vectorsWithAll"`
}

// coverage measures simCoverage for every size. The group by edges of a
// vector is the one its companions give: its own edges are not counted.
func (s *simIndex) coverage(sizes []int) (out []simCoverage, edges, vectors int) {
	postingOf := s.g.st.side.postingOf
	type tally struct {
		covered  [2][]int64
		mean     [2][]float64
		most     [2][]int64
		all      [2][]int64
		edges    int64
		vectors  int64
		rank     []uint16
		counts   []uint32
		touched  []uint32
		sorted   []uint32
		ownTo    []uint32
		ownCount []uint32
		hit      [2][]int
	}
	workers := runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)
	tallies := make([]tally, workers)
	for w := range tallies {
		tl := &tallies[w]
		for d := range 2 {
			tl.covered[d], tl.mean[d] = make([]int64, len(sizes)), make([]float64, len(sizes))
			tl.most[d], tl.all[d] = make([]int64, len(sizes)), make([]int64, len(sizes))
		}
		tl.rank, tl.counts = make([]uint16, len(s.members)), make([]uint32, len(s.members))
		tl.hit[0], tl.hit[1] = make([]int, len(sizes)), make([]int, len(sizes))
	}
	s.parallel(len(s.live), func(w, from, to int) {
		tl := &tallies[w]
		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
			q := s.live[i]
			// The rank of every posting of its group by centroids, from 1.
			for r, other := range s.near[q] {
				tl.rank[other] = uint16(r + 1)
			}
			// How many edges of its members lead to every other posting.
			tl.touched = tl.touched[:0]
			for _, id := range s.members[q] {
				for _, e := range s.edges(uint32(id)) {
					target := postingOf[e]
					if target == q {
						continue
					}
					if tl.counts[target] == 0 {
						tl.touched = append(tl.touched, target)
					}
					tl.counts[target]++
				}
			}
			tl.sorted = append(tl.sorted[:0], tl.touched...)
			better := func(countA uint32, a uint32, countB uint32, b uint32) bool {
				return countA > countB || (countA == countB && a < b)
			}
			slices.SortFunc(tl.sorted, func(a, b uint32) int {
				if better(tl.counts[a], a, tl.counts[b], b) {
					return -1
				}
				return 1
			})
			for _, id := range s.members[q] {
				list := s.edges(uint32(id))
				if len(list) == 0 {
					continue
				}
				tl.vectors++
				tl.edges += int64(len(list))
				// Its own edges by posting.
				tl.ownTo, tl.ownCount = tl.ownTo[:0], tl.ownCount[:0]
				for _, e := range list {
					target := postingOf[e]
					at := slices.Index(tl.ownTo, target)
					if at < 0 {
						tl.ownTo, tl.ownCount = append(tl.ownTo, target), append(tl.ownCount, 0)
						at = len(tl.ownTo) - 1
					}
					tl.ownCount[at]++
				}
				hit := &tl.hit
				clear(hit[0])
				clear(hit[1])
				for o, target := range tl.ownTo {
					n := int(tl.ownCount[o])
					if target == q {
						// An edge to its own posting, after a move: covered.
						for z := range sizes {
							hit[0][z] += n
							hit[1][z] += n
						}
						continue
					}
					if r := int(tl.rank[target]); r > 0 {
						for z, size := range sizes {
							if r <= size {
								hit[0][z] += n
							}
						}
					}
					// Its rank among the postings its companions point to.
					left := tl.counts[target] - tl.ownCount[o]
					if left == 0 {
						continue
					}
					rank := sort.Search(len(tl.sorted), func(k int) bool {
						other := tl.sorted[k]
						return !better(tl.counts[other], other, left, target)
					})
					for o2, other := range tl.ownTo {
						if other == q || tl.counts[other] == 0 {
							continue
						}
						unadjusted := better(tl.counts[other], other, left, target)
						adjusted := other != target && tl.counts[other]-tl.ownCount[o2] > 0 &&
							better(tl.counts[other]-tl.ownCount[o2], other, left, target)
						if unadjusted && !adjusted {
							rank--
						}
					}
					for z, size := range sizes {
						if rank < size {
							hit[1][z] += n
						}
					}
				}
				for d := range 2 {
					for z := range sizes {
						tl.covered[d][z] += int64(hit[d][z])
						share := float64(hit[d][z]) / float64(len(list))
						tl.mean[d][z] += share
						if share >= 0.9 {
							tl.most[d][z]++
						}
						if hit[d][z] == len(list) {
							tl.all[d][z]++
						}
					}
				}
			}
			for _, other := range s.near[q] {
				tl.rank[other] = 0
			}
			for _, target := range tl.touched {
				tl.counts[target] = 0
			}
		}
	})
	var allEdges, allVectors int64
	for w := range tallies {
		allEdges, allVectors = allEdges+tallies[w].edges, allVectors+tallies[w].vectors
	}
	for z, size := range sizes {
		cov := simCoverage{Size: size}
		for d, share := range []*simShare{&cov.ByCentroids, &cov.ByEdges} {
			var covered, most, all int64
			var mean float64
			for w := range tallies {
				covered, most, all = covered+tallies[w].covered[d][z], most+tallies[w].most[d][z], all+tallies[w].all[d][z]
				mean += tallies[w].mean[d][z]
			}
			share.Edges = float64(covered) / float64(max(allEdges, 1))
			share.Mean = mean / float64(max(allVectors, 1))
			share.Most = float64(most) / float64(max(allVectors, 1))
			share.All = float64(all) / float64(max(allVectors, 1))
		}
		out = append(out, cov)
	}
	return out, int(allEdges), int(allVectors)
}

// exactTruth is the exact nearest neighbors of every query among the vectors
// the copy holds.
func (s *simIndex) exactTruth(queries [][]float32, k int) [][]uint64 {
	workers := runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)
	best := make([][]topK, workers)
	for w := range best {
		best[w] = make([]topK, len(queries))
		for q := range best[w] {
			best[w][q].reset(k)
		}
	}
	s.parallel(len(s.live), func(w, from, to int) {
		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
			for _, id := range s.members[s.live[i]] {
				vector := s.vec(uint32(id))
				for q, query := range queries {
					d, _ := s.g.provider.SingleDist(query, vector)
					if d < best[w][q].worst() {
						best[w][q].push(id, d)
					}
				}
			}
		}
	})
	truth := make([][]uint64, len(queries))
	for q := range queries {
		var merged topK
		merged.reset(k)
		for w := range best {
			for _, item := range best[w][q].items {
				merged.push(item.id, item.dist)
			}
		}
		for _, item := range merged.sorted() {
			truth[q] = append(truth[q], item.id)
		}
	}
	return truth
}

// simScenario is one state of the copy, searched.
type simScenario struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	// Pending is the share of the vectors, the most recent, whose edges were
	// taken away, and Removed the share taken out of the copy at random.
	Pending float64 `json:"pendingShare,omitempty"`
	Removed float64 `json:"removedShare,omitempty"`
	Group   string  `json:"groupBy,omitempty"`
	Size    int     `json:"groupSize,omitempty"`
	OwnGone int     `json:"ownEdgesTakenAway,omitempty"`
	InvGone int     `json:"inverseEdgesTakenAway,omitempty"`
	Edges   int64   `json:"edges"`
	NoEdge  int     `json:"vectorsWithNoEdge"`
	// Random tells that the pending were picked at random, not the most
	// recent; Prov is the provisional edges they were given; Per the
	// postings of its group each target scored, 0 for all; Waves the waves
	// the vectors came in.
	Random   bool     `json:"pendingAtRandom,omitempty"`
	Prov     *simProv `json:"provisional,omitempty"`
	Per      int      `json:"postingsScoredPerVector,omitempty"`
	Waves    int      `json:"waves,omitempty"`
	Cost     *simCost `json:"events,omitempty"`
	Curve    simCurve `json:"search"`
	TookSecs float64  `json:"seconds"`
}

// TestSimTwoStep runs the scenarios of PE_SIM over the copy in memory of the
// index of PE_DIR, each from the index as it is, and writes PE_OUT after
// each. A scenario is one of:
//
//	cov               the coverage of today's edges by groups of 32 to 320
//	base              the index as it is
//	strip:X           the X % most recent vectors with no edge, out or in
//	po:X:D:G          then events that connect the pending, groups by D (a
//	                  by centroids, b by edges) of G postings
//	ra:X:D:G          then events that reconnect every member (X may be 0)
//	rdist             how the 5, 10, 25 and 50 % most recent spread over
//	                  the postings, next to as many at random
//	stripr:X          a random X % with no edge, out or in
//	prov:X:K          the X % most recent with provisional edges: of the
//	                  endpoints of the edges of their K nearest companions
//	provpo:X:K:D:G    then events over them, which keep the provisional
//	                  edges still among the nearest
//	pv:X:D:G:P        events that connect the pending, each scoring its
//	                  posting and the P of the G loaded nearest to itself
//	wave:N:D:G        everything by events, in N waves by arrival
//	lote:G            everything by the rule of the batch builder: the G
//	                  postings nearest to each vector, no inverse edge
//	proto:N:K:D:G:P   the insert in two steps as it would run, in N waves:
//	                  provisional edges from K companions as a wave comes,
//	                  then events over them; protop leaves the last wave
//	                  on its provisional edges
//	evprov:X:K:D:G:P  everything by events (P of the G loaded scored by each
//	                  vector, 0 for all) but the X % that came last, which
//	                  have provisional edges from K companions
//	del:X             X % of the vectors taken out at random
//	delra:X:D:G       then events that reconnect every member
//
// PE_DENSE tells that the doc ids of the index are its order of arrival.
func TestSimTwoStep(t *testing.T) {
	datasetDir, dir, out, spec := os.Getenv("PE_DATASET"), os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT"), os.Getenv("PE_SIM")
	if datasetDir == "" || dir == "" || out == "" || spec == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DATASET, PE_DIR, PE_OUT and PE_SIM given")
	}
	const k = 10
	dense := os.Getenv("PE_DENSE") != ""
	queries, truth, trainRows := readNightQueries(t, datasetDir, k)
	if dense {
		placeOf := make([]uint64, trainRows)
		for at, row := range simOrder(trainRows) {
			placeOf[row] = uint64(at)
		}
		for q := range truth {
			for i, row := range truth[q] {
				truth[q][i] = placeOf[row]
			}
		}
	}
	if limit := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_QUERIES", 1000)); limit > 0 && limit < len(queries) {
		queries, truth = queries[:limit], truth[:limit]
	}
	s := openSim(t, dir, dense)
	defer s.close(t)
	// PE_EXACT: the recall is against the exact neighbors among the vectors
	// of the index, computed here, for an index that does not hold every row
	// of the dataset.
	if os.Getenv("PE_EXACT") != "" {
		truth = s.exactTruth(queries, k)
	} else {
		require.Equal(t, trainRows, s.count, "the index holds every row of the dataset")
	}
	rescore := s.g.ix.rescoreLimitFor(k)
	pristine := s.snapshot()
	result := map[string]any{
		"dir": dir, "dataset": datasetDir, "dense": dense, "meta": s.g.meta, "livePostings": len(s.live),
		"queries": len(queries), "k": k, "rescore": rescore, "gomaxprocs": runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0),
	}
	var scenarios []simScenario
	write := func() {
		result["scenarios"] = scenarios
		writeNightJSON(t, out, result)
	}
	count := func() (edges int64, none int) {
		for _, q := range s.live {
			for _, id := range s.members[q] {
				edges += int64(s.deg[id])
				if s.deg[id] == 0 {
					none++
				}
			}
		}
		return edges, none
	}

	for _, name := range strings.Split(spec, ",") {
		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
		parts := strings.Split(name, ":")
		begin := time.Now()
		s.restore(pristine)
		number := func(i int) float64 {
			require.Greater(t, len(parts), i, "scenario %s", name)
			v, err := strconv.ParseFloat(parts[i], 64)
			require.NoError(t, err, "scenario %s", name)
			return v
		}
		sc := simScenario{Name: name}
		against := truth
		switch parts[0] {
		case "cov":
			coverage, edges, vectors := s.coverage([]int{32, 64, 128, 256, simGroupMax})
			result["coverage"] = coverage
			result["coverageEdges"], result["coverageVectorsWithEdges"] = edges, vectors
			for _, c := range coverage {
				t.Logf("groups of %d: by centroids %.1f %% of the edges (mean a vector %.1f %%, %.1f %% of the vectors with "+
					"90 %% or more, %.1f %% with all); by edges %.1f %% (%.1f %%, %.1f %%, %.1f %%)", c.Size,
					100*c.ByCentroids.Edges, 100*c.ByCentroids.Mean, 100*c.ByCentroids.Most, 100*c.ByCentroids.All,
					100*c.ByEdges.Edges, 100*c.ByEdges.Mean, 100*c.ByEdges.Most, 100*c.ByEdges.All)
			}
			write()
			continue
		case "base":
		case "strip", "po", "ra":
			sc.Pending = number(1) / 100
			var pending []bool
			if sc.Pending > 0 {
				pending = s.recent(sc.Pending)
				sc.OwnGone, sc.InvGone = s.strip(pending)
			}
			if parts[0] != "strip" {
				require.Len(t, parts, 4, "scenario %s", name)
				sc.Group, sc.Size = parts[2], int(number(3))
				if pending == nil {
					pending = make([]bool, s.keys)
				}
				cost := s.events(t, sc.Group, sc.Size, rescore, pending, parts[0] == "ra", nil, simEventOpts{})
				sc.Cost = &cost
			}
		case "rdist":
			// How the most recent vectors spread over the postings, next to
			// as many picked at random.
			var spreads []map[string]any
			for _, share := range []float64{0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50} {
				recent, random := s.spread(share, s.recent(share)), s.spread(share, s.random(share))
				spreads = append(spreads, map[string]any{"share": share, "recent": recent, "random": random})
				t.Logf("the %.0f %% most recent: share of a posting p1 %.3f p10 %.3f p50 %.3f p90 %.3f p99 %.3f max %.3f, %d "+
					"postings with none, %.1f %% of them in postings with twice the share, %.2f edges out and %.2f in a "+
					"vector | at random: p1 %.3f p10 %.3f p50 %.3f p90 %.3f p99 %.3f max %.3f, %d with none, %.1f %%, %.2f "+
					"out and %.2f in", 100*share, recent.P1, recent.P10, recent.P50, recent.P90, recent.P99, recent.Max,
					recent.None, 100*recent.InTwice, recent.OutEdges, recent.InEdges, random.P1, random.P10, random.P50,
					random.P90, random.P99, random.Max, random.None, 100*random.InTwice, random.OutEdges, random.InEdges)
			}
			result["recentSpread"] = spreads
			write()
			continue
		case "stripr":
			// The edges of a share of the vectors picked at random taken away.
			sc.Pending, sc.Random = number(1)/100, true
			sc.OwnGone, sc.InvGone = s.strip(s.random(sc.Pending))
		case "prov", "provpo", "provi", "provipo", "provn", "provnpo":
			// The pending get provisional edges; with provpo, events over
			// them, which compare those edges exactly with their candidates.
			sc.Pending = number(1) / 100
			pending := s.recent(sc.Pending)
			sc.OwnGone, sc.InvGone = s.strip(pending)
			prov := s.provisional(t, pending, int(number(2)), simInverseOf(parts[0]))
			sc.Prov = &prov
			if strings.HasSuffix(parts[0], "po") {
				require.Len(t, parts, 5, "scenario %s", name)
				sc.Group, sc.Size = parts[3], int(number(4))
				cost := s.events(t, sc.Group, sc.Size, rescore, pending, false, nil, simEventOpts{keepOwn: true})
				sc.Cost = &cost
				// Every pending vector is connected: its notices are done.
				s.notices = nil
			}
		case "pv":
			// Events that connect the pending, each scoring its posting and
			// the postings of the group loaded that are nearest to it.
			require.Len(t, parts, 5, "scenario %s", name)
			sc.Pending = number(1) / 100
			pending := s.recent(sc.Pending)
			sc.OwnGone, sc.InvGone = s.strip(pending)
			sc.Group, sc.Size, sc.Per = parts[2], int(number(3)), int(number(4))
			cost := s.events(t, sc.Group, sc.Size, rescore, pending, false, nil, simEventOpts{perVector: sc.Per})
			sc.Cost = &cost
		case "evprov":
			// The state an index that inserts in two steps is in: no vector
			// has an edge of today; those that came first are connected by
			// events, with only them in the index, and the X % that came
			// last have provisional edges.
			require.Len(t, parts, 6, "scenario %s", name)
			sc.Pending = number(1) / 100
			sc.Group, sc.Size, sc.Per = parts[3], int(number(4)), int(number(5))
			everyone := s.recent(1)
			sc.OwnGone, sc.InvGone = s.strip(everyone)
			last := s.recent(sc.Pending)
			first := make([]bool, s.keys)
			for id := range first {
				first[id] = everyone[id] && !last[id]
			}
			boundary := uint32(float64(s.count) * (1 - sc.Pending))
			cost := s.events(t, sc.Group, sc.Size, rescore, first, false, nil, simEventOpts{perVector: sc.Per, upTo: boundary})
			sc.Cost = &cost
			prov := s.provisional(t, last, int(number(2)), 0)
			sc.Prov = &prov
		case "proto", "protop", "protoi", "protoip", "proton", "protonp":
			// The insert in two steps as it would run: no vector has an edge
			// of today, and the vectors come in N waves; those of a wave get
			// provisional edges as they come, and then events connect them,
			// comparing those edges exactly with their candidates. With
			// protop the last wave is left on its provisional edges: pending.
			require.Len(t, parts, 6, "scenario %s", name)
			sc.Waves = int(number(1))
			sc.Group, sc.Size, sc.Per = parts[3], int(number(4)), int(number(5))
			everyone := s.recent(1)
			sc.OwnGone, sc.InvGone = s.strip(everyone)
			sc.Pending = 1
			var total simCost
			var prov simProv
			wave := make([]bool, s.keys)
			for w := range sc.Waves {
				from, to := uint32(int64(s.count)*int64(w)/int64(sc.Waves)), uint32(int64(s.count)*int64(w+1)/int64(sc.Waves))
				for id := range wave {
					wave[id] = everyone[id] && s.place[id] >= from && s.place[id] < to
				}
				prov.add(s.provisional(t, wave, int(number(2)), simInverseOf(parts[0])))
				if strings.HasSuffix(parts[0], "p") && w == sc.Waves-1 {
					sc.Pending = 1 / float64(sc.Waves)
					break
				}
				total.add(s.events(t, sc.Group, sc.Size, rescore, wave, false, nil,
					simEventOpts{keepOwn: true, perVector: sc.Per, upTo: to}))
				// The wave is connected: its notices are done.
				s.notices = nil
			}
			sc.Cost, sc.Prov = &total, &prov
		case "lote":
			// Everything connected by the rule of the batch builder: each
			// vector looks at the G postings nearest to itself.
			require.Len(t, parts, 2, "scenario %s", name)
			sc.Pending, sc.Size = 1, int(number(1))
			sc.OwnGone, sc.InvGone = s.strip(s.recent(1))
			cost := s.batchLike(t, sc.Size, rescore)
			sc.Cost = &cost
		case "wave":
			// Everything by events, in waves by the order of arrival: no
			// vector has an edge, and each wave connects its vectors with
			// only those that have come by then in the index.
			require.Len(t, parts, 4, "scenario %s", name)
			sc.Pending, sc.Waves = 1, int(number(1))
			sc.Group, sc.Size = parts[2], int(number(3))
			everyone := s.recent(1)
			sc.OwnGone, sc.InvGone = s.strip(everyone)
			var total simCost
			wave := make([]bool, s.keys)
			for w := range sc.Waves {
				from, to := uint32(int64(s.count)*int64(w)/int64(sc.Waves)), uint32(int64(s.count)*int64(w+1)/int64(sc.Waves))
				for id := range wave {
					wave[id] = everyone[id] && s.place[id] >= from && s.place[id] < to
				}
				total.add(s.events(t, sc.Group, sc.Size, rescore, wave, false, nil, simEventOpts{upTo: to}))
			}
			sc.Cost = &total
		case "del", "delra":
			sc.Removed = number(1) / 100
			rng := rand.New(rand.NewPCG(5, 9))
			gone := make([]bool, s.keys)
			for _, q := range s.live {
				for _, id := range s.members[q] {
					if rng.Float64() < sc.Removed {
						gone[id] = true
					}
				}
			}
			s.remove(gone)
			against = s.exactTruth(queries, k)
			if parts[0] == "delra" {
				require.Len(t, parts, 4, "scenario %s", name)
				sc.Group, sc.Size = parts[2], int(number(3))
				cost := s.events(t, sc.Group, sc.Size, rescore, nil, true, nil, simEventOpts{})
				sc.Cost = &cost
			}
		default:
			t.Fatalf("scenario %s: not one of cov, base, strip, po, ra, del, delra, rdist, stripr, prov, provpo, pv, wave, evprov, proto, protop (provi, provipo, protoi, protoip: the provisional edges also enter the lists of their neighbors; provn, provnpo, proton, protonp: they leave them notices)", name)
		}
		sc.Edges, sc.NoEdge = count()
		sc.Curve = s.curve(t, queries, against)
		sc.TookSecs = time.Since(begin).Seconds()
		scenarios = append(scenarios, sc)
		write()
		line := ""
		for _, point := range sc.Curve.Points {
			line += " | " + strconv.FormatFloat(point.Target, 'f', 2, 64) + ": ef " + strconv.Itoa(point.EF) + ", " +
				strconv.FormatFloat(point.Loads, 'f', 2, 64) + " loads"
		}
		for _, point := range sc.Curve.Grid {
			if point.EF == 20 || point.EF == 160 {
				line += " | ef " + strconv.Itoa(point.EF) + ": " + strconv.FormatFloat(point.Recall, 'f', 4, 64) + ", " +
					strconv.FormatFloat(point.Loads, 'f', 2, 64)
			}
		}
		costLine := ""
		if sc.Cost != nil && sc.Cost.Connected > 0 {
			c := sc.Cost
			costLine = " | events " + strconv.Itoa(c.Events) + ", " + strconv.FormatFloat(c.PendingPerEvnt, 'f', 1, 64) +
				" connected each, " + strconv.FormatFloat(float64(c.Loads)/float64(c.Connected), 'f', 2, 64) + " loads, " +
				strconv.FormatFloat(float64(c.Scored)/float64(c.Connected), 'f', 0, 64) + " scored and " +
				strconv.FormatFloat(float64(c.Exact)/float64(c.Connected), 'f', 0, 64) + " exact a vector, " +
				strconv.FormatFloat(1e3*c.CPUSeconds/float64(c.Connected), 'f', 3, 64) + " ms of CPU a vector"
		}
		if sc.Prov != nil && sc.Prov.Vectors > 0 {
			v := sc.Prov
			costLine = " | provisional: " + strconv.Itoa(v.Vectors) + " vectors, " +
				strconv.FormatFloat(float64(v.Companions)/float64(v.Vectors), 'f', 0, 64) + " companions and " +
				strconv.FormatFloat(float64(v.Endpoints)/float64(v.Vectors), 'f', 0, 64) + " endpoints by code, " +
				strconv.FormatFloat(float64(v.Edges)/float64(v.Vectors), 'f', 2, 64) + " edges and " +
				strconv.FormatFloat(1e6*v.CPUSeconds/float64(v.Vectors), 'f', 1, 64) + " us of CPU a vector, " +
				strconv.Itoa(v.NoEdge) + " left with none, " +
				strconv.FormatFloat(float64(v.InverseEdges)/float64(v.Vectors), 'f', 2, 64) + " lists entered and " +
				strconv.FormatFloat(float64(v.Notices)/float64(v.Vectors), 'f', 2, 64) + " notices a vector (" +
				strconv.Itoa(v.NoticeTargets) + " vectors hold some, " + strconv.Itoa(v.NoticeMax) + " the most)" + costLine
		}
		t.Logf("%s: %d edges, %d vectors with none%s%s (%s)", name, sc.Edges, sc.NoEdge, line, costLine,
			time.Since(begin).Round(time.Second))
	}
}

// simInverseOf tells from the name of a scenario how its provisional edges
// reach the neighbors: not at all (0), into their lists by code (1: provi,
// protoi), or as notices (2: provn, proton).
func simInverseOf(kind string) int {
	switch {
	case strings.HasPrefix(kind, "provi"), strings.HasPrefix(kind, "protoi"):
		return 1
	case strings.HasPrefix(kind, "provn"), strings.HasPrefix(kind, "proton"):
		return 2
	}
	return 0
}

// simJointCell is what the searches of the pending vectors of a posting
// share, for one count of pending a posting, summed over the postings
// sampled: of the postings they load, of the members of those postings, of
// the endpoints they score and of the exact vectors their rescores read, how
// many in all and how many distinct within a posting's group.
type simJointCell struct {
	Pending           int   `json:"pending"`
	Postings          int   `json:"postings"`
	Searches          int   `json:"searches"`
	LoadsTotal        int64 `json:"loadsTotal"`
	LoadsDistinct     int64 `json:"loadsDistinct"`
	MembersTotal      int64 `json:"membersTotal"`
	MembersDistinct   int64 `json:"membersDistinct"`
	EndpointsTotal    int64 `json:"endpointsTotal"`
	EndpointsDistinct int64 `json:"endpointsDistinct"`
	ExactTotal        int64 `json:"exactTotal"`
	ExactDistinct     int64 `json:"exactDistinct"`
}

// TestSimJoint measures what an event by joint search would share
// (bench-report.md, "El evento por búsqueda conjunta", pre-registered on
// 2026-11-28 by the user's order): of PE_POSTINGS postings picked at random
// from the copy of the index of PE_DIR, the most of PE_JOINT members each,
// picked at random, are left with no edge, out or in, as a pending vector is;
// the search of an insert runs for each as the index runs it (its entry
// postings, its ef, its rescore), and what it loads, scores and reads is
// kept. For every count of PE_JOINT, the first so many of a posting are its
// pending.
func TestSimJoint(t *testing.T) {
	dir, out, spec := os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT"), os.Getenv("PE_JOINT")
	if dir == "" || out == "" || spec == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DIR, PE_OUT and PE_JOINT given")
	}
	var counts []int
	for _, field := range strings.Split(spec, ",") {
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(field))
		require.NoError(t, err, "PE_JOINT")
		counts = append(counts, n)
	}
	slices.Sort(counts)
	most := counts[len(counts)-1]
	sample := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_POSTINGS", 200))
	s := openSim(t, dir, os.Getenv("PE_DENSE") != "")
	defer s.close(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	postingOf := s.g.st.side.postingOf

	// The postings and their pending vectors.
	rng := rand.New(rand.NewPCG(21, 7))
	var eligible []uint32
	for _, q := range s.live {
		if len(s.members[q]) >= 2*most {
			eligible = append(eligible, q)
		}
	}
	rng.Shuffle(len(eligible), func(i, j int) { eligible[i], eligible[j] = eligible[j], eligible[i] })
	picked := eligible[:min(sample, len(eligible))]
	chosen := make([][]uint32, len(picked))
	gone := make([]bool, s.keys)
	for i, q := range picked {
		ids := s.members[q]
		for _, m := range rng.Perm(len(ids)) {
			id := uint32(ids[m])
			if postingOf[id] != q {
				continue
			}
			chosen[i] = append(chosen[i], id)
			gone[id] = true
			if len(chosen[i]) == most {
				break
			}
		}
	}
	ownGone, inverseGone := s.strip(gone)

	// The search of an insert for each.
	type seen struct {
		loads, endpoints, exact []uint32
		members                 int
	}
	results := make([][]seen, len(picked))
	entries := max(int(s.g.ix.entryPostings.Load()), 1)
	var failed atomic.Pointer[error]
	var next atomic.Int64
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	begin := time.Now()
	for range runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0) {
		wg.Add(1)
		enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			for {
				i := int(next.Add(1)) - 1
				if i >= len(picked) {
					return
				}
				results[i] = make([]seen, len(chosen[i]))
				for j, v := range chosen[i] {
					r := &results[i][j]
					search := &fetchedSearch{
						ix: s.g.ix, st: s.g.st, rounds: &s.rounds, fetch: s.fetch, grown: true,
						haloWords: s.g.meta.RoutingCodeWords, ef: s.g.insertEF,
						onEndpoints: func(slots []uint32) { r.endpoints = append(r.endpoints, slots...) },
						onRescore: func(candidates []scored) {
							for _, c := range candidates {
								r.exact = append(r.exact, uint32(c.id))
							}
						},
					}
					vector := s.vec(v)
					entry, err := s.g.st.centroids.nearest(ctx, vector, entries)
					if err != nil {
						failed.Store(&err)
						return
					}
					stats := diskSearchStats{KeepLoaded: true}
					if _, _, err := search.run(ctx, vector, s.g.meta.Neighbors, entry, &stats); err != nil {
						failed.Store(&err)
						return
					}
					for _, p := range entry {
						r.loads = append(r.loads, uint32(p))
					}
					r.loads = append(r.loads, stats.Loaded...)
					slices.Sort(r.loads)
					r.loads = slices.Compact(r.loads)
					for _, p := range r.loads {
						r.members += len(s.members[p])
					}
				}
			}
		}, s.logger)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	if err := failed.Load(); err != nil {
		require.NoError(t, *err)
	}
	took := time.Since(begin)

	var cells []simJointCell
	for _, m := range counts {
		cell := simJointCell{Pending: m}
		loads, endpoints, exact := map[uint32]struct{}{}, map[uint32]struct{}{}, map[uint32]struct{}{}
		for i := range picked {
			if len(results[i]) < m {
				continue
			}
			cell.Postings++
			clear(loads)
			clear(endpoints)
			clear(exact)
			for j := 0; j < m; j++ {
				r := &results[i][j]
				cell.Searches++
				cell.LoadsTotal += int64(len(r.loads))
				cell.MembersTotal += int64(r.members)
				cell.EndpointsTotal += int64(len(r.endpoints))
				cell.ExactTotal += int64(len(r.exact))
				for _, p := range r.loads {
					loads[p] = struct{}{}
				}
				for _, e := range r.endpoints {
					endpoints[e] = struct{}{}
				}
				for _, x := range r.exact {
					exact[x] = struct{}{}
				}
			}
			cell.LoadsDistinct += int64(len(loads))
			for p := range loads {
				cell.MembersDistinct += int64(len(s.members[p]))
			}
			cell.EndpointsDistinct += int64(len(endpoints))
			cell.ExactDistinct += int64(len(exact))
		}
		cells = append(cells, cell)
		n := float64(max(cell.Searches, 1))
		t.Logf("%d pending a posting, %d postings: a search loads %.1f postings, scans %.0f members, scores %.0f endpoints and "+
			"reads %.0f exact vectors; a vector of a joint event, %.2f postings (%.1f times fewer), %.0f members, %.0f "+
			"endpoints (%.1f) and %.1f exact vectors (%.1f)", m, cell.Postings, float64(cell.LoadsTotal)/n,
			float64(cell.MembersTotal)/n, float64(cell.EndpointsTotal)/n, float64(cell.ExactTotal)/n,
			float64(cell.LoadsDistinct)/n, float64(cell.LoadsTotal)/float64(max(cell.LoadsDistinct, 1)),
			float64(cell.MembersDistinct)/n, float64(cell.EndpointsDistinct)/n,
			float64(cell.EndpointsTotal)/float64(max(cell.EndpointsDistinct, 1)), float64(cell.ExactDistinct)/n,
			float64(cell.ExactTotal)/float64(max(cell.ExactDistinct, 1)))
	}
	writeNightJSON(t, out, map[string]any{
		"dir": dir, "meta": s.g.meta, "livePostings": len(s.live), "postingsSampled": len(picked), "counts": counts,
		"insertEF": s.g.insertEF, "entryPostings": entries, "neighbors": s.g.meta.Neighbors,
		"rescore": s.g.ix.rescoreLimitFor(s.g.meta.Neighbors), "ownEdgesTakenAway": ownGone,
		"inverseEdgesTakenAway": inverseGone, "searchSeconds": took.Seconds(), "gomaxprocs": runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0),
		"cells": cells,
	})
}

// simStageHook reads the CPU of the process every time the batch builder
// logs that a stage is done.
type simStageHook struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	stages []map[string]any
	begin  time.Time
}

func (h *simStageHook) Levels() []logrus.Level { return logrus.AllLevels }

func (h *simStageHook) Fire(entry *logrus.Entry) error {
	stage, ok := entry.Data["stage"].(string)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	usage, err := readDiagRusage()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.stages = append(h.stages, map[string]any{
		"stage": stage, "took": entry.Data["took"], "atSeconds": time.Since(h.begin).Seconds(),
		"cpuSecondsSoFar": float64(usage.UserNs+usage.SystemNs) / 1e9,
	})
	h.mu.Unlock()
	return nil
}

// TestSimBatchBuild builds the index of the first PE_ROWS rows of the
// dataset (all without it) with the batch builder, in memory, and writes to
// PE_OUT what each of its stages took, with the CPU of the process at the
// end of each: the cost of its stage of edges, apart from the partition and
// the assignment.
func TestSimBatchBuild(t *testing.T) {
	datasetDir, out := os.Getenv("PE_DATASET"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT")
	if datasetDir == "" || out == "" || os.Getenv("PE_BATCHBUILD") == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DATASET, PE_OUT and PE_BATCHBUILD given")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	train, err := openNightTrain(datasetDir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer train.file.Close()
	nightRows(t, train)
	ids := make([]uint64, train.rows)
	for i := range ids {
		ids[i] = uint64(i)
	}
	vectors, _, err := train.read(ids, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for i := range vectors {
		vectors[i] = distancer.Normalize(vectors[i])
	}

	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.DebugLevel)
	logger.SetOutput(os.Stderr)
	hook := &simStageHook{begin: time.Now()}
	logger.AddHook(hook)
	cfg := testConfig(t, vectors, 0, distancer.NewCosineDistanceProvider())
	cfg.Logger = logger
	uc := NewDefaultUserConfig()
	ix, err := New(cfg, uc)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	const batch = 10000
	for from := 0; from < len(ids); from += batch {
		to := min(from+batch, len(ids))
		require.NoError(t, ix.AddBatch(ctx, ids[from:to], vectors[from:to]))
	}
	before, err := readDiagRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	begin := time.Now()
	hook.begin = begin
	require.NoError(t, ix.Build(ctx))
	took := time.Since(begin)
	after, err := readDiagRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	stats, ok := ix.BuildStats()
	require.True(t, ok, "the index was built")
	n := float64(stats.Vectors)
	writeNightJSON(t, out, map[string]any{
		"dataset": datasetDir, "vectors": stats.Vectors, "postings": stats.Postings, "edges": stats.Edges,
		"gomaxprocs": runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0), "buildProbe": uc.BuildProbe, "rescueLimit": uc.RescueLimit,
		"seconds": took.Seconds(), "cpuSeconds": float64(after.UserNs+after.SystemNs-before.UserNs-before.SystemNs) / 1e9,
		"cpuSecondsBefore": float64(before.UserNs+before.SystemNs) / 1e9,
		"partitionSeconds": stats.PartitionTime.Seconds(), "assignSeconds": stats.AssignTime.Seconds(),
		"encodeSeconds": stats.EncodeTime.Seconds(), "edgeSeconds": stats.EdgeTime.Seconds(),
		"centroidGraphSeconds":    stats.CentroidGraphTime.Seconds(),
		"postingsProbedPerVector": float64(stats.PostingsProbed) / n, "candidatesScoredPerVector": float64(stats.CandidatesScored) / n,
		"candidatesRescoredPerVector": float64(stats.CandidatesRescored) / n, "edgesPerVector": float64(stats.Edges) / n,
		"edgeVectorsPerSecond": n / stats.EdgeTime.Seconds(), "stages": hook.stages,
	})
	t.Logf("%d vectors in %d postings: partition %s, assign %s, edges %s (%.0f vectors a second, %.0f postings and %.0f "+
		"candidates by code and %.0f exact a vector), in all %s", stats.Vectors, stats.Postings,
		stats.PartitionTime.Round(time.Second), stats.AssignTime.Round(time.Second), stats.EdgeTime.Round(time.Second),
		n/stats.EdgeTime.Seconds(), float64(stats.PostingsProbed)/n, float64(stats.CandidatesScored)/n,
		float64(stats.CandidatesRescored)/n, took.Round(time.Second))
}
